label: Deadline for paying retirement benefits after leaving
unit: days from the date the entitlement arises
appliesTo: Employers, on every departing employee entitled to retirement benefits
why: The most useful date to know on the way out, and the one most often replaced in conversation by 'next payroll run'. It also interacts badly with a departure flight: an employee leaving Korea a week after their last day can be gone before the statutory deadline even expires.

history.source: Act on the Guarantee of Workers’ Retirement Benefits
history.note: Payable within 14 days of the date the entitlement arises. The period can be extended by agreement between the parties where there are special circumstances — an agreement, not a unilateral decision by the employer.
